description:
Your developer program status

Everything that decides what the signed-in wallet can do in the developer program: `stage` (`subscribe` = no account and no paid plan, `agreement` = the current agreement is not signed yet, `portal` = a member in good standing, `suspended`), whether the current agreement is signed, the wallet's own plan, and its developer account (with `can_publish`). It explains a developer route's `DEVELOPER_AGREEMENT_REQUIRED` or `PAID_PLAN_REQUIRED` refusal. A trial plan reads `paid: false`: it does not count for joining or publishing.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).
name: get_developer_program_status

can_publish.description: Whether a publish would succeed now (current agreement signed and an active paid plan)

id.description: Your developer ID; manifests carry it as `author.developerId`

account.description: Null when the wallet has no developer account

accepted.description: Whether the CURRENT version is signed

accepted_version.description: The latest version this wallet signed, current or not

developer_plan_beta.description: The Developer plan in beta, for this wallet

available.description: This account can switch it on now

in_beta.description: The Developer plan is still in beta, and free while it is

reason.description:
Why it cannot be switched on, when `available` and `on` are both false: `DEVELOPER_AGREEMENT_REQUIRED`,
`PAID_PLAN_REQUIRED`, `ALREADY_INCLUDED` (the account's plan is Developer or above) or `NOT_IN_BETA`.

plan.description: The wallet's own Chain Daddy plan, as the program's gates read it

beta.description: Present and true when `tier` is a plan in beta the wallet switched on over the plan it pays for

paid.description: An active plan other than free that is not a trial. Joining and publishing need this.

paid_tier.description: The plan the wallet pays for, when `beta` is true. `expires_at` is that plan's.

tier.description: Plan tier, lowercase (empty with no plan)

stage.description:
`subscribe`: no developer account and no paid plan. `agreement`: sign the current agreement.
`portal`: a member in good standing. `suspended`: program access is suspended.

title: Get my developer program status
